title: Recourse for Residents Faced With Long-term Water Seepage Problems in HDB Flats
what_it_is: Recourse for Residents Faced With Long-term Water Seepage Problems in HDB Flats

sections.label: Town Councils repair external wall leaks
sections.summary: Town Councils are responsible for investigating and repairing external wall leaks reported to them, as external walls of HDB blocks are common property.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: As the external walls of HDB blocks are common property, Town Councils are responsible for investigating and repairing external wall leaks reported to them.

sections.label: No compensation or flat buyback
sections.summary: There are no plans for HDB to offer compensation or buy back flats, as water seepage issues can be resolved once leak sources are identified and repairs carried out.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: As water seepage issues can be resolved once the sources of leaks have been identified and repair works are duly carried out, there are no plans for HDB to offer compensation or to buy back the flats.

sections.label: HDB works with Town Councils
sections.summary: HDB has been working closely with Town Councils and flat owners to carry out tests, identify leak sources, and recommend methods to rectify the situation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: And for those cases, we have been working very closely with the Town Councils, as well as the flat owner to carry out tests, to identify the sources of leaks, to recommend methods and procedures to try to rectify the situation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: And my assurance to the Member is that HDB will continue to work very closely with the Town Councils and the flat owners to rectify and resolve those issues.

sections.label: GRA scheme cost-sharing details
sections.summary: The GRA scheme, implemented administratively since April 2001, has HDB arrange repairs and co-pay 50%, with the remaining 50% shared between upper and lower flat owners at $300 per repair location.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: The GRA scheme was implemented administratively since April 2001, and HDB arranges for repair works and co-pays 50% of the cost, and the other remaining 50% will be co-shared between the upper floor and the lower floor flat owners, kept at $300 per repair location.

sections.label: Encouraging amicable resolution of leaks
sections.summary: The Member urges all parties to resolve leak issues amicably, with HDB facilitating and co-paying 50% under the GRA scheme, and MPs and advisors engaging residents.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
sentences.text: The reason why I ask is because it is often the case that, especially, when the leak emanates from the upper floor, it does not really affect one neighbour but it affects the downstairs neighbour, and this often leads to a lot of foot-dragging, in terms of their willingness to proceed with their cost-sharing.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: We want to resolve those issues as quickly as possible, understanding that it causes disamenities and inconveniences to residents, especially in the lower floor.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: HDB can play a role to facilitate, to bring conversations together, but there may be real challenges in getting both parties to meet and talk.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: For those issues, I urge all parties to come to an amicable resolution, that is what the GRA scheme is meant to help, to incentivise the resolution of the conclusion with HDB coming forward to pay 50% of the costs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: So, I do encourage all Members of Parliament and advisors to speak to your residents, engage them, and if need be, please rope in the Town Councils and approach HDB.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: We will look at it on a case-by-case basis and try to help as much as we can.
